title: UI风格#110 - Kawaii Grunge (可爱垃圾)
description: 创建第110种UI风格：可爱垃圾风格 - 粉彩与垃圾摇滚、破碎与可爱并存。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDF.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Grunge style When color palette Then features pastel pink, ripped black, mint green, safety orange
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FFB6C1 (粉), #1C1C1C (黑), #98FB98 (薄荷), #FF6600 (安全橙), #DDA0DD (淡紫)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Grunge style When typography Then uses contrast fonts: Chunk Five, Miss Pillow, or Pacifico
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Chunk Five (粗体), Miss Pillow (可爱), Pacifico (混合)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Grunge style When layout Then torn paper, sticker overlays, spray paint, xerox textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：撕纸、贴纸叠加、喷漆、静电复印纹理

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Grunge style When UI elements Then sticker animations, glitch bursts, grunge textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：贴纸动画、故障爆发、垃圾纹理、混搭效果

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Grunge UI When functional Then includes grunge chat, rebel agents, chaos stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：垃圾聊天、反叛代理、混沌统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kawaii Grunge UI When copy Then uses anti-establishment: 'Riot', 'Rebel', 'Chaos', 'Cutie'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'RIOT. REBEL. CUTIE.'、按钮'SEND'→'SMASH'、'SUBMIT'→'SHRED'
